messages:
anna: Quick heads up — we need to claim the cloud storefront listing across AWS/GCP/Azure before EOD Tue. Legal + Product + Infra please: I'll lay out the gaps I saw.

mike: What exact gaps? EULA, pricing, or data processing? :thinking_face:

anna: All three. Specifics: (1) EULA needs localization + export control clause; (2) SKU taxonomy differs per cloud — we need canonical SKUs; (3) trial entitlement flow and subscription tiers for marketplace.

jia: Can product own canonical SKUs? I can draft mapping table. Need hero screenshots + trial config. Also need trial SKU quota and coupon behavior from billing.

ravi: Infra: we need org-level provisioning + service account with publisher IAM roles. MarketplaceBot just pinged that our org isn't verified on GCP yet.

MarketplaceBot: [automated] GCP org verification: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/publisher -> org verification pending. Status: action required by admin@redwood.com

mike: For EULA/localization: propose base EULA + country addendum. I'll loop in localization vendor. Also need legal contacts for Azure/Oracle export controls.

anna: RJ from sales said Azure wants separate trial flow (30-day vs 14-day). Jia, can you propose a default and a per-cloud override?

jia: Yes. Default: 14-day trial + 1 vCPU dev tier for free. Per-cloud override table in spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/marketplace-trials

ravi: For IAM/terraform, here's a quick snippet we can use for publisher SA creation:
```
resource "google_service_account" "publisher" {
  account_id   = "rw-publisher-sa"
  display_name = "Redwood Marketplace Publisher"
}
```

anna: Perfect. Mike — can you confirm if the SA needs any special disclosure in the EULA? Also legal needs the packaging assets list: logo sizes, screenshots, landing copy.

mike: SA itself ok. We need data processing details for telemetry — include a short paragraph in the privacy/data section.

jia: I'll assemble the packaging checklist and the assets folder by tomorrow. Can someone provide marketing-approved hero images?

anna: @marketing please? (not in this thread) — marketing: any chance to accelerate hero image handoff by EOD Mon?

ravi: I'll open a PR for terraform and add cloud-specific role bindings. Ping me when the canonical SKUs spreadsheet is ready.

anna: Thanks team. Next sync: 11am Mon. I'll create calendar and link the sheet. :thumbsup:
